shell.helpText: We're here to make your work easier.
shell.helpBody: Use the search box to find an offer, or create a new one from scratch.

auth.subtitle: Log in to your quotations workspace.
auth.resetText: Enter your username and we will send reset instructions.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's what's happening with your quotations today.

list.title: Offers
list.subtitle: Find, manage, and keep track of every offer.
list.empty: No offers found. Try another search.

builder.title: New Offer
builder.subtitle: Fill in the details. Your document updates as you go.
builder.packagingHint: Choose a customer, then add your materials and quantities.

basics.customerHint: The customer drives the address and the default payment terms.
basics.paymentTermHint: The due date is the issue date shifted by the term.
basics.referenceHint: The reference is entered by hand
basics.referenceInputHint: Type the offer number exactly as it should be printed.
basics.attentionHint: This name is printed on the offer and can be edited per offer.

packaging.empty: No materials yet. Add one from the catalogue above.

taxes.taxHint: Percentage added on top of the subtotal.
taxes.otherTaxHint: Applies a fixed 1% of the subtotal as a deduction.

notes.label: Notes
notes.hint: Free text printed under the offer. The terms and conditions are not printed.

preview.title: Document preview
preview.hint: The document updates with every field you change.

review.title: Review before issuing
review.hint: Check the reference and the totals, then issue the offer.
review.bankNote: The bank details for the total of {total} {currency} are printed on the document.

validation.customer: Choose a customer before saving the offer.
validation.lines: Add at least one material before saving the offer.

details.title: Offer details
details.notFound: This offer could not be found.
details.noVersions: This offer has no other versions yet.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Every client you quote, with their history in one place.
customers.name: Customer
customers.empty: No customers yet. Add your first customer to start quoting.
customers.noHistory: No offers for this customer yet.

products.title: Materials & Products
products.subtitle: Keep your material catalogue, packaging and prices ready to quote.
products.empty: No materials yet. Import a list or add one manually.

import.title: Data Import
import.subtitle: Bring customers, materials and prices into the workspace.
import.chooseSource: Choose what you want to import
import.dropFile: Drop an Excel or CSV file here

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Company details, packaging and everything that prints on an offer.
settings.logoHint: The logo prints at approximately 55 × 25 mm on every offer.
settings.bankHint: All bank accounts listed here appear on every offer.
settings.remindBeforeExpiry: Remind me before an offer expires
settings.remindDays: Remind me this many days before expiry
settings.pdfLanguageHint: The document language is independent from the application language.

account.title: My Account
account.subtitle: Your profile and your personal preferences.
account.name: Full name
account.largeTextHint: Increase the text size across the workspace.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.subtitle: The page you are looking for does not exist or was moved.
